name: Mipmap-GS
definition: A plug-in optimization method that makes 3D Gaussians adaptive for arbitrary scales by self-adjusting primitive properties (color, shape, size) and distribution (position) using scale-specific mipmap-like pseudo ground-truth.
summary: Mipmap-GS is a test-time adaptation method that deforms pre-trained 3D Gaussians to eliminate aliasing artifacts at varying zoom factors, distinguishing itself by self-adjusting primitive properties rather than using post-processing filters.
